note: Per-lot roof colour read on the Google Earth top views (imagery 2026-03-11): the median of the 60 % core of the roof polygon, written by tools/anime/earth-roofs.mjs. Derived colour values only: no imagery. Used to fit the GSI -> Earth roof transform (scripts/anime/enrich/fold.js) and as the held-out reference of its gate (test/sys-round2.test.js). skip: readings that must not train anything or set a colour (pv: solar modules; veg: the GSI photo colour is a tree; var: two captures disagree by more than 15 L*).
